annotations.title: Find a business by what it does and where

description: Businesses that confirmed their own facts at INITE and proved their domain, found by what they do and where, in English, Russian, Portuguese or Spanish ("a dentist in Lisbon", "кафе в Москве"). Each answer gives the name, what it does in its own words, its city, its first services with prices as confirmed, its site, and its company facts server (MCP and A2A) for hours, every service and questions, or to send it a request. For which AI tool or app to use, call match_tools or atlas_lookup on the INITE Atlas, not this. Ordered by how well the words match and how complete the confirmed facts are; no business can pay for a place. Free, no account.

city.description: Only businesses with a location in this city, in any spelling ("Lisboa", "Lisbon")

country.description: Only businesses with a location in this country: a name in any of the four languages, or its two-letter code

language.description: A language the business serves in, as a code ("pt") or a name; businesses that name none come after the rest

offset.description: The nextOffset of the previous answer

query.description: What the business is or does, or what the person wants from it, e.g. "dentist", "wedding photographer", "corte de cabelo masculino". A place in it counts too.

name: find_business
title: Find a business by what it does and where
